prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the details of your injuries and case. Based on the available information, I’d start by interviewing **two or three local options**, such as:

- **Law Offices of Stephen M. Fuerch** — has a Pleasanton office and advertises car-accident representation and a free case evaluation. [Firm website](https://www.fuerchlegal.com/practice-areas/personal-injury/car-accidents/)
- **GJEL Accident Attorneys** — says it handles Pleasanton and Tri-Valley injury cases and offers a free case review. [Pleasanton page](https://www.gjel.com/pleasanton)
- **Kline Simon Law Firm** — has a Pleasanton office and lists car accidents among its practice areas. [Attorney profile](https://www.avvo.com/attorneys/94566-ca-paulo-klinesimon-3563765.html)

These are starting points, not endorsements; directory ratings and firms’ own claims don’t establish who will be right for your case. Before hiring, ask who will personally handle your file, how often they take car-injury cases to trial, what similar cases they’ve handled, and how fees and case expenses work if there’s no recovery. Check the attorney’s current status and public discipline history through the [State Bar of California attorney search](https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/).

If you’re injured, prioritize medical care and keep copies of medical records, bills, photos, and insurer communications. Avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer or signing a settlement release before you understand the consequences. This is general information, not legal advice.
